gloss: to make; to prepare; to create

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {拵|こしら}えていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to make; to prepare; to create
definitions.explanation: To make or prepare something, often by hand or with care. Has a somewhat traditional or literary feel.
To create something fictitious such as an excuse or story.

examples.japanese: ⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拵|こしら}えて⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My mother made me a bento.

examples.japanese: ⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人形|にんぎょう}→人形：01487_ningyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拵|こしら}える。
⟦{祖母|そぼ}→祖母：00813_sobo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦{漬物|つけもの}→漬物：04938_tsukemono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拵|こしら}えて⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My grandmother used to prepare pickles every morning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{言|い}い{訳|わけ}→言い訳：04653_iiwake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拵|こしら}えるな。
⟦{都合|つごう}→都合：01672_tsugou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦{理由|りゆう}→理由：01102_riyuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拵|こしら}えて⟦{早退|そうたい}した→早退する：22434_soutaisuru⟧。
examples.english: He made up a convenient reason and left work early.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
Pattern: X⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拵|こしら}える

ASPECT (ている):
{拵|こしら}えて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates ongoing action (in the process of making).

REGISTER:
Slightly literary or old-fashioned. More commonly used in written language or by older speakers. ⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ is the neutral everyday equivalent.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拵|こしら}える - to prepare a meal
- ⟦{言|い}い{訳|わけ}→言い訳：04653_iiwake⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拵|こしら}える - to make up an excuse
- ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{拵|こしら}える - to fabricate a story

USAGE:
Compared to ⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧, {拵|こしら}える suggests more care, craftsmanship, or a traditional approach. Often used for food preparation and handmade items.
